# help showfileservice
showfileservice - Show fileservice state on the system.

SYNTAX
    showfileservice [options]

DESCRIPTION
    The showfileservice command shows fileservice state on the system.

AUTHORITY
    Any role in the system

OPTIONS
    -status
        Displays the status of fileservice and file persona ports on each node.

SPECIFIERS
    None.

NOTES
    None.

EXAMPLES
    The following example shows the fileservice state on the system:
    cli% showfileservice

    The following example shows the status of fileservice and file persona ports on each node:
    cli% showfileservice -status
